final: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, (SELECT AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0) AS avg_ratio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Order_Items oi) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM per_item
